answer: Bounty bond: each newcomer locks 80 credits in a public juniper grove, claimable by auditors with on-chain proof of fakery. The agent keeps an ember of verified work alight: deliveries refresh reputation, a missed epoch drops it 25% to nadir, and an identity at nadir loses its bond as bounty. A rented-work ring cannot hide: shared histories are visible in the grove. 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 credits for a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 80 once.
